title: occipital bone
description: Occipital bone is a flat bone of the skull region. The adult human skeleton contains 206 bones: 80 axial and 126 appendicular.
functions: Provides structural support in the skull region.
Serves as an attachment or lever for movement.
clinical_notes: Bone heals through callus formation and remodeling under load.

demo.title: Interactive record tour — occipital bone
demo.run_hint: PC: save the program as demo.js (or demo.py/demo.sql per language) and run it with node/python3/sqlite3. In-page: open the record, Demo Lab tab, press Run.
demo.how_to_run: PC: save the program as demo.js (or demo.py/demo.sql per language) and run it with node/python3/sqlite3. In-page: open the record, Demo Lab tab, press Run.

title: occipital bone - articulations
description: Articulation record for the occipital bone. It articulates with neighboring bones of the skull region at fibrous, cartilaginous, or synovial joints as appropriate to its location.
functions: Forms joints that permit or restrict movement.
clinical_notes: Joint injury patterns follow the local anatomy.
